args.content: The Python 3.12 release introduces several significant improvements and new features. A major highlight is the enhanced CPython data model, which allows for more precise and efficient handling of data structures. The language also sees improvements in typing, with the introduction of type parameter syntax for generic classes and functions, making type hinting more flexible and readable. Error messages have been made more helpful, providing better guidance for debugging common issues. Additionally, performance optimizations have been implemented throughout the interpreter, leading to faster execution of Python code. The standard library has also been updated with new modules and enhancements to existing ones, further expanding Python's capabilities.
